newsitem.title: USA: Apple sees '97 revenue at $8-$8.5 billion.
newsitem.headline: Apple sees '97 revenue at $8-$8.5 billion.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc revenue for fiscal 1997 will be $8 to $8.5 billion, sharply below last year's $9.83 billion, because of weak consumer personal computer sales, the company's finance chief said.

In reporting a $120 million loss for its fiscal first quarter, ended December 27, Fred Anderson, Apple's chief financial officer, also said Apple will have to slice off another $400 million in yearly expenses.
Anderson confirmed plans announced earlier this month for further restructuring in the current quarter ending March, which could include further job cuts.
